name: unibridge
description: Root workspace runner for Unibridge Microservices

scripts.dev:server: concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue,green,gray,red" "npm run dev:attendance" "npm run dev:chat" "npm run dev:mail" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:outpass" "npm run dev:task" "npm run dev:user"
scripts.dev: concurrently -c "white,cyan,magenta,yellow,blue,green,gray,red" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:attendance" "npm run dev:chat" "npm run dev:mail" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:outpass" "npm run dev:task" "npm run dev:user"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server/attendance-service && npm install --prefix server/chat-service && npm install --prefix server/mail-service && npm install --prefix server/notification-service && npm install --prefix server/outpass-service && npm install --prefix server/task-service && npm install --prefix server/user-service
